category_title: Children who resist teacher instructions and break classroom rules
minimal_context: The student is expected to join a group activity in the kindergarten classroom.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Everyone, it is time for our group activity. Please sit in the circle.

STUDENT: (Leaves the group area without permission and runs aimlessly, not participating in the class activity.)

TUTOR: Please come back and sit still for the activity.

STUDENT: (Remains silent, showing an inability to sit still and difficulty with the directions.)

TUTOR: You need to finish the activity with the rest of the class.

STUDENT: (Stays completely silent, barely engaging in the kindergarten activity, and continues to wander aimlessly.)

options.A: Implement a program to encourage 'tootling' by providing a collective class reward for prosocial behavior.
options.B: Adhere to a strict routine and provide positive reinforcement for desired behaviors, such as stickers.
options.C: Deliver a structured mindfulness program consisting of twelve hour-long sessions, generally twice-weekly.
options.D: Develop joint assessment models in which teachers collaborate with psychologists or trained observers.
